question: What was the monthly honorarium announced by the Odisha government for Padma Awardees, starting January 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**₹30,000**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Odisha government**, led by Chief Minister **Mohan Charan Majhi**, announced a revision in the monthly honorarium for the state's **Padma Awardees**.
 
• Starting from **January 2025**, the monthly honorarium for these distinguished individuals will be increased to **₹30,000**.
 
• Before this announcement, the awardees were receiving a monthly sum of **₹25,000**; thus, an increment of **₹5,000** has been implemented.
 
• This financial support is provided to recipients of the **Padma Vibhushan**, **Padma Bhushan**, and **Padma Shri** who hail from the state of **Odisha**.
 
• The decision reflects the state's commitment to honoring and supporting eminent personalities who have made significant contributions to **Arts**, **Science**, **Literature**, **Social Work**, and other fields.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **The Padma Awards:**
 
 
• These are among the highest civilian honors in **India**, instituted in the year **1954**.
 
• The awards are announced every year on the occasion of **Republic Day** (**January 26**).
 
• The awards are classified into three categories: **Padma Vibhushan** (for exceptional and distinguished service), **Padma Bhushan** (distinguished service of high order), and **Padma Shri** (distinguished service in any field).
 
 
 
• **Odisha's Recognition:**
 
 
• Several individuals from **Odisha** have been conferred with these awards for their mastery in **Odissi dance**, **Pattachitra painting**, **tribal welfare**, and **linguistics**.
 
• In the **2024 Padma Awards** list, personalities like **Gopinath Swain** (Art), **Bhagabat Padhan** (Art), and **Binod Kumar Pasayat** (Art) from **Odisha** were among the notable recipients.
 
 
 
• **Welfare Initiatives:**
 
 
• States in **India** often provide additional perks to **Padma Awardees**, such as **monthly stipends**, **health insurance**, or **free travel** on state-run buses, to ensure their well-being in their **old age**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Eligibility:** The honorarium is generally provided to those awardees who are in need of financial assistance or as a mark of state respect, depending on the specific **state government guidelines**.
 
• **Implementation:** The **₹30,000** amount is set to be credited to the accounts of the beneficiaries from the first month of **2025**.
 
• **Selection Process:** While the **State Government** provides the honorarium, the selection for the **Padma Awards** is done by the **Padma Awards Committee**, which is constituted by the **Prime Minister** every year.
